title: How deep the seasons reach
query: Using the supplied CMEMS global biogeochemical reanalysis monthly oxygen, chlorophyll and nitrate for 1993-2020 in the western Tasman Sea off south-eastern Australia (46-26 S, 147-162 E), determine to what depth a seasonal cycle can be detected in each variable, how its size and timing change with depth and latitude, where it is not a simple annual wave, and what the time lags between depths and between variables suggest about how the seasonal signal is carried downward. Temperature, mixing and light are not supplied; state what that prevents you from concluding.

region.name: Tasman Sea and East Australian Current
